purpose: Group evidenced target units into centralized, modular, or explicitly seam-backed extraction boundaries.
evidenceRule: Every context and extract cites target unit IDs and coupling or seam evidence.
instructions: Act as the system architect for the full target map. Prefer a modular ColdBox monolith: most domains stay main-app. Use coldbox-module only for cohesive in-process feature boundaries (not every folder). Use external-service only for separate side-app/microservice deployables with an explicit Application/hosting seam. Domain-clustering alone never implies a module or microservice.
